task.description: Validate CODE-DESIGNER Step 01 artefacts for PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-01, PIN-02. IMPORTANT decision point: CODE-DESIGNER flagged PIN-01 as having TWO of its four resolution branches genuinely un-implementable in this batch -- AC1 (catalog-version resolution) blocked because service_catalog has no version/status column at all (a product/schema decision outside this design's authority), and AC2 (module-ref resolution) blocked because PLC-01 (the module catalog) does not exist yet. Filed as ISS-0672 (MAJOR) and commented on existing GH-306. Only AC3 (variable_schema validation) and AC4 (pin_overrides) are implementable now. Decide: (a) does this design correctly and honestly scope PIN-01 to what CAN be built now, with AC1/AC2 clearly marked as blocked-not-deferred rather than silently dropped, (b) is it acceptable for BACKEND-DEV to implement PIN-01 AC3/AC4 only in this batch with AC1/AC2 explicitly left for a future run once their blockers clear, or (c) should PIN-01 be pulled from this batch entirely since half its AC surface cannot be implemented. Also validate PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-02 normally (full design coverage expected, no known gaps).
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in PAR-05, PAR-06, PIN-02 is traced to a specific design section
PIN-01 AC3/AC4 are fully covered; AC1/AC2's blocked status is honestly and clearly documented, not silently dropped or glossed as future work without explanation
Independent judgment on whether PIN-01's partial scope is acceptable for this batch or whether it should be deferred/pulled entirely
No implementation code (Zig function bodies, SQL DDL outside Type C YAML)
Lego catalog classification correctly applied per templates/lego-catalog.md
tools/lint_design_artefact.py run against each artefact with 0 BLOCKER
